canonical_information_definition.observation_days: Last 5 regular business/trading days of each calendar month.
canonical_information_definition.maturities: Nearest and second-nearest standard Nikkei 225 option maturities.
canonical_information_definition.put_strike_rule: Nearest OTM put = maximum strike strictly below same-day Nikkei 225 reference close.
canonical_information_definition.call_strike_rule: Nearest OTM call = minimum strike strictly above same-day Nikkei 225 reference close.
canonical_information_definition.spot_source: Same official OSE/Osaka Exchange daily report: reference Nikkei 225 OHLC/close on the futures page.
canonical_information_definition.daily_pcr_formula: 100 * (put volume at selected strike for near maturity + put volume at selected strike for second-near maturity) / (call volume at selected strike for near maturity + call volume at selected strike for second-near maturity).
canonical_information_definition.monthly_pcr_formula: Arithmetic mean of the five daily PCR observations.
canonical_information_definition.holiday_session_rule: For modern holiday trading sessions, preserve Tsuji's regular business-day convention; Japanese national-holiday sessions are not counted as separate month-end business days.

rights_and_storage.historical_source: National Diet Library Digital Collection / NDL Search daily OSE and Osaka Exchange reports
rights_and_storage.current_source: JPX official daily-report JSON/ZIP for the recent period not yet ingested by NDL
rights_and_storage.225labo_use_at_data_gate: Trading-date calendar QA only; no price/return outcome use.
rights_and_storage.public_repo_allowed: Source identifiers/URLs, hashes, parser provenance, coverage manifests, non-reconstructive derived PCR and validation results subject to source terms.

coverage_gate.usable_contiguous_interpretation: From 2009-07 through 2026-08, all month-end five-business-day sets are covered except 2010-06.

schema_and_parser_gate.known_issue: Some older PDF text layers split sparse auction volume/value digits, e.g. '49  200  201602' into spaced glyph sequences. Coordinate-based row fallback must recover this without manual correction.
schema_and_parser_gate.formal_gate: Do not label data feasibility PASS until fixed-sample cross-era parser QA passes.
schema_and_parser_gate.latest_regression: 9/9 PASS after legacy no-trade and weekly-row fixes

zero_denominator_rule: Daily PCR undefined when selected near+second-near call volume is zero; month unusable if any of five required daily PCRs is undefined. No rescue.
